lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor twenty-six. Two hundred megawatts. Sable Reach requested a channel before you arrived. Meridian Actual has authorised you to take it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Authorised. Not ordered.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Yolanda. May I? — Two things, and one of them is true whether or not you like me. The Ordinal did not lose a war here.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: They wrote the order, they lit sixty-one anchors, and they stayed at the posts. You've read it. You know it isn't a defence order.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: How do you have the order.
lines.beat: not a question — Okonkwo already knows the only ways he could

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Second thing. My crews come through in twenty minutes either way. I'd rather they walked past you than through you.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Twenty minutes was generous of him.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Their heavies are screened. Anything not rated for it is landing a quarter of what it should.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: A quarter still kills.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Eventually. The lance does it now.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: You're holding well. I want you to understand that I'd have taken you at anchor nineteen if I'd wanted a fight.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: And this is what?

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: A demonstration. For a third party. I'm sorry about that part.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez. He's routing his people past the seam, not at the ring. They aren't trying to take the anchor.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Then what are we losing men to?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: An invoice, I think.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over capacity. He can hear that, by the way — the whole ring drops a tone.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. No transit — it walked past the ring.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Everything on the ring. Let the rest of it walk.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Thank you, Captain. That was exactly the number I needed.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: What number.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: What it costs to hold one of these against a serious effort. Somebody's buying that answer.
lines.beat: the level was a measurement, and Meridian was the instrument

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Control, log the whole channel. Every word he said about the order was accurate.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Logged. That is noted with concern.
